source_text: Lepra in veste — vitium in conversatione vel doctrina. Combure quod insanabile. Nova vestis Christi.
pass_a_gloss: Leprosy in garment — vice in conduct or doctrine. Burn what incurable. New garment of-Christ.
pass_b_english: [[Leprosy in a garment >> Bible:Leviticus 13:47]] — vice in habit or teaching. Burn what cannot be healed. Put on Christ’s new garment.
